name: Cadenya agentic runtime landing page by Cadenya
description: The page runs a two-typeface system — a light uppercase display serif against small monospace labels — and threads a technical-drawing motif of 1px crop-mark corner brackets through every framed panel, diagram and photo. Rhythm comes from full-bleed background swaps down the page: off-white hero with a surreal floating bonsai island, a macro root photograph carrying two frosted-glass cards, deep forest-green panels with numbered node diagrams and an accordion/product-UI split, then a pale lime zone for FAQ before returning to white for the closing CTA and footer. The bonsai-on-island image recurs three times as a brand anchor, and a single lime accent (#D9E965-ish) marks focal diagram nodes, the highlighted phrase in the oversized statement, and interactive states.
